text.name: Wizard's Ring
text.description:
{Wizard's Ring}

Increases the hero's knowledge by 1, and regenerates 1 spell point per day
text.event: You stumbled upon a gang of marauders stealing utensils from a magician's tower. Some carried books, some scrolls, and some wands. You probably wouldn’t have gotten anything, but when you entered the tower, you did find one item in a jug in the kitchen - the Wizard's Ring.
